subject: RFP bake-off: competitive credit match request / Veridian Health
messages:
From: Elliot Johnson <elliot.j@veridianhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sachin Patel <sachin.p@veridianhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-28 09:18 AM PDT
Subject: RFP bake-off: vendor credits and timing

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile. We have our vendor bake-off calendar locked for the week of June 14 and our procurement team has asked each vendor to provide a 30–60 day sandbox with a minimum of 50k token-equivalent credits so our ML infra team can run head-to-head throughput tests.

One of the incumbent vendors has offered us a promotional top-up for this RFP. To be competitive, can Redwood match or provide an alternative credit structure (mix of trial credits + short-term discounted reserved capacity)?

We need the credits provisioned and an ops contact before June 8 to onboard. I attached the RFP doc for context.

Appreciate quick clarity on policy limits and any approvals required.

Best,
Elliot
Head of ML Platform
Veridian Health

Attachment: Veridian_RFP.pdf (pdf stub)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-28 10:02 AM PDT
Subject: Fwd: RFP bake-off: vendor credits and timing

Aditya / Marissa — forwarding Veridian's request. Short ask: they want ~50k token credits (30–60 days) plus an ops onboarding contact by June 8. Competitor table: incumbent offering top-up + temporary discounted nodes for the benchmark window.

Why I think we should escalate:
- Veridian is a high-priority mid-market target (payer network).
- Benchmarks will directly compare latency and cost-per-token under realistic load.
- If we don't match something similar, incumbent advantage (they already have SSO + infra integration) could bias results.

Proposed options for approval:
A) Approve 50k eval credits + 2-week discounted dedicated burst (monthly invoice credit) — requires credit sign-off from Sales Ops.
B) Approve 75k credits (one-off) without discounted nodes — requires manager-level approval (policy exception).

Marissa: can you outline the downstream billing and provisioning steps if we do A vs B and estimate hit to promotional budget?
Aditya: can you approve up to 75k credits for this RFP or do we need leadership sign-off?

Thanks — I can join a quick sync with procurement if helpful.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0173
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-28 12:46 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP bake-off: vendor credits and timing

Hannah — thanks for the clear options. I agree we should be competitive here. Approvals:
- I can approve up to 50,000 eval credits from the regional promotional pool without additional sign-off.
- Anything above 50k (e.g., your B option at 75k) needs Sales Leadership exception (I can escalate, but want a one-paragraph justification for margin / strategic upside).

Given the timeline and Veridian's influence in payer-core market, here's what I recommend to move fast:
1) Approve option A immediately (50k credits + 2-week discounted burst). Marissa: please prepare the promo record and provisioning playbook.
2) I'll draft a short justification to support a 75k exception if the customer pushes for parity with incumbent. Hannah, please collect the incumbent offer (numbers) and a quick one-liner on strategic rationale so I can include it in the exception note.

Also confirm whether the discounted nodes are time-limited (2 weeks) and whether we attach an evaluation success criteria (e.g., latency < X p95) to the promo. If they pass, we'll discuss conversion incentives.

Aditya
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-28 16:42 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP bake-off: vendor credits and timing — provisioning steps

Thanks — I will action option A today. Summary of next steps for ops:
- Create promo record in HubSpot (deal VER-2026-RFP-88) and tag as "RFP-subsidy". Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/VER-2026-RFP-88
- Provision 50,000 token-equivalent eval credits to a sandbox org for veridianhealth.com (expires 2026-07-31).
- Schedule a 60-minute onboarding window with our Solutions Engineering (SE) team; target June 9–11. SE contact: se-onboard@redwood.com.
- If customer pushes for parity with incumbent, escalate to Aditya with the competitor offer and a one-paragraph strategic justification; prepare a one-time invoice credit template for discounted nodes.

Attachments: proposed-subsidy-terms.xlsx (spreadsheet stub) — contains token accounting, expiry, and conversion credits.

I'll provision the credits after I get Veridian's acceptance email (short approval reply okay). Hannah — can you capture the exact incumbent numbers if they share them so we can expedite the exception?

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
